# 0x004010cb      mov eax, 1
# 0x004010d0      xor ecx, ecx          ; ecx = 0 (accumulator)
# 0x004010d8      movzx edx, byte [rbx + rax - 1]   ; edx = char at (rax-1), so when rax=1, char at index 0
# 0x004010dd      lea esi, [rax + 1]                ; esi = rax + 1
# 0x004010e0      add rax, 1                        ; rax++

# 0x004010e7      add ecx, edx                      ; ecx += edx

# - When rax=2: char[1] * (2+1) = char[1] * 3
# - ...

#
# Sum must equal 0x2a3a = 10810
